policy.class_a_requirement: Fixed-seed trajectory, action, log probability, value, hidden state, PPO generation boundary, checkpoint-resume and end-to-end throughput equivalence.
policy.class_b_requirement: Class A safety checks plus numeric error, NaN/Inf, long-episode and three-seed small-scale learning evidence.
policy.class_c_requirement: Separate algorithm experiment with at least three learning seeds and fixed-match strength comparisons; never merge as implementation-only speed work.

candidates.description: Complete mutually exclusive worker, central inference and learner timing plus optional system monitoring.
candidates.semantics: Instrumentation only; timing disabled must preserve the existing execution path and throughput within run variance.

candidates.description: Scan central inference batch wait at 0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 ms.
candidates.semantics: Episode RNG and recurrent state remain isolated; weights stay fixed for the complete rollout generation.

candidates.description: Scan 2/3/4/5/6 rollout workers and 1/2/4 PyTorch threads per worker.
candidates.semantics: Only execution parallelism changes; matchup schedule, per-episode seeds and PPO generation boundaries stay fixed.

candidates.description: Reduce inference IPC messages and reuse or preallocate request/result buffers.
candidates.semantics: Every request retains episode, player, step and generation identity; payload values and ordering contracts are unchanged.

candidates.description: Reuse the observation already returned by reset/step instead of requesting the same state-version observation again.
candidates.semantics: The v4.1 manifest, hidden-information boundary, token order, values and dtypes are unchanged.

candidates.description: Write the fixed 93-token v4.1 layout into reusable contiguous arrays without temporary dictionaries or lists.
candidates.semantics: Byte-for-byte observation and card-index outputs are required for audited states.

candidates.description: Validate card-index bounds and live action-mask rows on CPU before H2D, then omit redundant device-scalar validation inside every forward.
candidates.semantics: Default policy calls still reject invalid card indices and empty legal-action rows; prevalidated training calls must produce exact logits, value and hidden state.

candidates.description: Register fixed v4.1 semantic-byte, player, leader, zone, history and record positions as non-persistent model buffers.
candidates.semantics: The buffers must move with the model, remain absent from checkpoint state dictionaries, and preserve logits, value and hidden state bit-for-bit.

candidates.description: Share rounded categorical slices, choice values and semantic-kind masks without changing any per-field clamp range.
candidates.semantics: Merged and original conversions must agree for arbitrary finite floats, and policy logits, value and hidden state must remain bit-for-bit identical.

candidates.description: Remove actionable fixed-input permute/contiguous work and merge equivalent small projections only when their measured ceiling is material.
candidates.semantics: Any implemented layout or projection merge must preserve the observation schema and policy outputs.

candidates.description: Evaluate an equivalent native scaled-dot-product-attention backend after the token and layout gates.
candidates.semantics: Logits, value and recurrent hidden state must meet the registered exact/tolerance contract on every tested batch bucket.

candidates.description: Cache genuinely static inference-only card encodings.
candidates.semantics: No training graph or gradient-bearing value may be cached; policy outputs must remain equivalent.

candidates.description: Capture stable inference batch buckets only after host synchronization is removed, with dynamic tails kept on the eager path.
candidates.semantics: Capture must preserve request order, RNG use, hidden-state ownership, policy generation and exact outputs.

candidates.description: Reuse rollout tensors and move invariant padding and mask construction outside the minibatch loop.
candidates.semantics: Minibatch permutation, valid tokens, losses, gradients, optimizer steps and checkpoint state remain equivalent.

candidates.description: Skip padded sequence rows during learner forward and backward without changing valid-token ordering or minibatch membership.
candidates.semantics: Every valid token, recurrent boundary, loss, gradient, optimizer step and PPO generation stays fixed; only invalid padded rows may be omitted.

candidates.description: Evaluate zero-grad, foreach gradient clipping and fused optimizer implementations independently.
candidates.semantics: Parameter groups, gradients, clipping threshold, Adam state and optimizer step count remain equivalent.

candidates.description: Overlap CPU preparation, host-to-device copies and CUDA work inside the same synchronous rollout or learner generation.
candidates.semantics: Workers never observe updating weights and no policy generation lag is introduced.

candidates.description: Evaluate learner-only FP16 and BF16 autocast with the appropriate gradient scaling contract.
candidates.semantics: Rollout data flow and PPO batches stay fixed, but learner numeric outputs, gradients and optimizer trajectory may drift.

candidates.description: Batch valid v4.1 structured-token encoding across each learner minibatch before recurrent stepping.
candidates.semantics: Rollout, minibatch membership, valid-token order, recurrent boundaries and PPO losses stay fixed, but larger encoder batches introduce bounded floating-point drift.

candidates.description: Evaluate TF32, FP16 autocast and BF16 autocast independently.
candidates.semantics: Data flow stays fixed, but numeric outputs and optimizer behavior may change.

candidates.description: Evaluate torch.compile first-call cost, steady-state gain, graph breaks, checkpoint compatibility and Windows stability.
candidates.semantics: Kernel fusion or operation ordering may introduce numeric drift and Windows stability risk.

candidates.description: Asynchronous actor/learner execution with policy lag.
candidates.semantics: Changes the behavior-policy generation and PPO on-policy boundary.

candidates.description: Change rollout length, sequence length, epochs or minibatch size for throughput.
candidates.semantics: Changes sampling or optimization semantics even when network code is unchanged.

candidates.description: Reduce Observation content or network width/depth.
candidates.semantics: Changes policy inputs or capacity and therefore learning semantics.
